svg.title: pos-partial
svg.desc: Rotated (teal) versus position-free (grey) dimensions per head, from configs: GPT-NeoX-20B 24 of 96, GLM-4.5 64 of 128, MiniMax-M2 64 of 128, Phi-4-mini 96 of 128, MiMo-V2-Flash 64 of 192, Qwen3-Next 64 of 256, Gemma 4 global 128 of 512, DeepSeek-V4 64 of 512, DeepSeek-V3 MLA lane 64 of 192. Right: at the same 25 percent, NeoX-style partial RoPE in Qwen3-Next keeps wavelengths 6 to 38M tokens, while p-RoPE in Gemma 4 keeps only 6 to 188 tokens and sets 192 pairs to zero frequency. Bottom right: reported Gemma 2B perplexity at 8K: NoPE 4.86, RoPE 4.46, 0.25-RoPE 4.53, 0.75-RoPE 4.44.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
